_comment: MP-423 — edge functions that are ACTIVE in prod with NO source in this repo.
These are NOT tolerated defects that got baselined for convenience. Each one
is source code that exists in exactly one place on earth: the Supabase edge
runtime. If prod loses it, it is gone. And because every repo guard walks
supabase/functions, NONE of them has ever graded these files —
check-ilike-user-input (the MP-422 wildcard that minted a session on a
the enum/CHECK vocabulary guards, check-relation-exists. All blind, all six.
The baseline is a NAMED SET, not a count (MP-356/MP-357: a count-only floor
is fungible — a real regression can sit red until an unrelated pay-down
absorbs it, and a brand-new ungoverned endpoint passes green so long as the
total does not rise). A slug not listed here fails the next deploy.
This file shrinks by RECOVERING source, never by adding slugs.

MP-476 (2026-09-08): daily-brief PAID DOWN — supabase/functions/daily-brief/ now exists, so the guard sees repo source for it. Removed here per the rule above: this file shrinks by recovering source. Separately, ACTIVE count fell 259 -> 232 and the novel orphan mp457-service-branch-probe was DELETED from prod rather than baselined — it was MP-457's own throwaway probe, whose source said 'inert; delete when a working Supabase PAT exists'. Backup of its body: ~/business-ops/website-integrity-bot/retired-function-backups/.
